acceptanceCriteria.text: Candidate workflows cannot attest removal or alteration of their own required trusted policy; provenance is immutable and source-external.
Bind final eligibility to the dedicated GitHub App issuer and immutable exact author/review/source receipts; maintain existing native author and reviewer separation.
Required canceled, skipped, filtered, absent or stale checks cannot become green; preserve exact pinned toolchains and existing protection.
Validate exact H/B/tree, main drift, nested merges, conflicting batches and policy-update cases with one shared writer and explicit expected-head integration.
No key/token enters candidate jobs/source or tests; App/rules/native issuer activation remains a separately qualified Root operation after exact review/integration.

body.outcome: Implement trusted CI policy, dedicated issuer bindings and serialized integration
body.remainingWholeWork: S05-S08 and actual primary pair/C3 then Academy, other permitted runtimes/custody/retirement remain separate. AGY remains suspended by later actual user decision.
